This chain implies that Prednisolone may exert a role in the pathophysiology of Nephrotic Syndrome, possibly through mechanisms involving inflammation or renal dysfunction. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationships are inferred through indirect pathways and are not directly observed. The mechanism by which Prednisolone influences Nephrotic Syndrome remains unclear, but the existing evidence supports a possible pharmacological link. Further research would be needed to establish a definitive causal relationship.
